newsitem.title: USA: Science Dynamics to exceed Q2 projections.
newsitem.headline: Science Dynamics to exceed Q2 projections.

text.p: Science Dymamics Corp said Tuesday it foresaw earnings for the second quarter surpassing initial projections, describing itself as a stronger company than it was a year ago.
The company said it also expected to free itself of long-term debt during the quarter.

"We have increased our operating efficiencies and reduced costs substantially, as we have focused on creating new products to serve our existing markets and on developing products for the fast-growing computer telephony integration market," it said.

"Our cash on hand has increased by more than $500,000 since the end of 1996," it added. "Sales for the first quarter were slightly above expectations and we expect to exceed our initial projections for the second quarter."
The company reported a loss of $0.02 a share for the first quarter on sales of $1.1 million against a loss of $0.10 on $548,481 a year ago.
A spokeswoman for the company said it would pay off a total of $500,000 in debt, including $400,000 in long-term debt and $100,000 as the current portion.

Science Dynamics, with headquarters in Cherry Hill, makes telecommunications products like voice announcement systems and others with call processing and voice response capabilities for telephone companies.
